full_judgment: 6. The plaintiff-petitioner being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree preferred Title Appeal No. 241 of 1977 which was also dismissed by the Additional District Judge 3rd Court, Barisal. On consideration of evidence on record the appellate court recorded the following finding:-'As the plaintiff has got no title or possession in the suit laud and as he has not made any prayer in this suit for declaration of title and for any consequential relief either in the Arm confirmation of possession or recovery of khas possession so it can be safely said that the plaintiff has got no locus-standi to bring the suit and that suit is nor maintainable in its present form" Being aggrieved by the aforesaid decision of the appellate Court, the plaintiff petitioner moved a revisional application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure and obtained the present Rule.
